svg.text: A practical two-motor wiring guide · detached connector function keys
One paired housing on J2 pins 2 / 3
Pin 1 = V+ · direct from PD VBUS
Pin 2 = A · green / Pin 3 = B · blue
J2 pins 1 and 4–8 are unused here.
J1 GND and J2 GND are common.
Function key · cavity order not shown
Function key · cavity order not shown
20 V nominal after PD negotiation. Verify voltage and polarity before connecting motors.
Lines show electrical pairing; use compatible mating parts. Motor cavity order is not specified.
